classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve UniProt sequences annotated with NAD(P)HX repair GO terms (ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase GO:0034021 and NADPHX epimerase GO:0034022), search supporting literature, run sequence analysis on both sets, and rank representative candidates across both functional families.
assumptions: GO:0034021 is used as the molecular-function term for ADP-dependent (S)-NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity; sequences from this term represent the dehydratase arm of the NAD(P)HX repair system.
GO:0034022 is used as the molecular-function term for NADPHX epimerase activity; sequences from this term represent the epimerase arm.
No taxonomic filter is applied so all kingdoms are included, maximising representative diversity across both GO terms.
deduplicate_sequences=true is set on both go_sequences calls to prevent redundant accessions inflating the candidate pool.
sequence_analysis is run at pH 7.4 (physiological) to capture biologically relevant charge and region annotations for each set.

rank_designs aggregates representative_sequences (candidates) and metrics (analyses) from both sequence_analysis nodes; default composite scoring is used because no custom ranking weights were provided.
Literature search provides contextual evidence about NAD(P)HX repair biology but does not gate workflow execution.
max_sequences=500 per GO term is a practical cap that preserves broad taxonomic diversity without overloading downstream analysis.

success_criteria.go_sequences_dehydratase: FASTA file retrieved for GO:0034021 containing at least one sequence
success_criteria.go_sequences_epimerase: FASTA file retrieved for GO:0034022 containing at least one sequence
success_criteria.literature_nadphx: At least five publications returned with abstracts covering NAD(P)HX repair biology
success_criteria.seq_analysis_dehydratase: Metrics, regions, and representative_sequences produced for dehydratase FASTA
success_criteria.seq_analysis_epimerase: Metrics, regions, and representative_sequences produced for epimerase FASTA
success_criteria.rank_nadphx: Top-10 ranked candidates returned with composite scores spanning both functional families
